_about: Service duties and activities that commonly contribute to chronic wear-and-tear conditions. Used as the IN-SERVICE EVENT for chronic musculoskeletal (and some other) claims. VA must consider 'the places, types, and circumstances of service' (38 U.S.C. 1154(a); 38 CFR 3.303(a), 3.306(b)(2)). These are leads for the Veteran's statement and a doctor's nexus opinion, not proof by themselves. Created by EhrenAL. KILLROYWASHERE

duties.label: Airborne jumps
duties.desc: Static-line or free-fall parachute jumps and hard landings
duties.proof: Parachutist badge (DD-214/ERB/ORB), jump log, jump master records

duties.label: Ruck marching with heavy loads
duties.desc: Long road marches with a full rucksack
duties.proof: Unit training records, schools, awards, buddy statements

duties.label: Body armor and full combat load
duties.desc: Wearing body armor, helmet and gear for long periods
duties.terms: heavy body armor|combat load|battle load|load carriage|wearing (body armor|military gear)

duties.label: Armored vehicles
duties.desc: Climbing on and off tanks, Bradleys, MRAPs; jarring rides
duties.proof: MOS, unit type, deployment records, buddy statements

duties.label: Demanding schools (Ranger, SF, Sapper, etc.)
duties.desc: Long, high-stress schools with heavy loads and little sleep
duties.proof: Tab or badge on DD-214, school certificate
duties.terms: ranger school|sapper school|special forces|q course|pathfinder|dahlonega|camp merrill|camp frank d\.? merrill|camp rogers|camp darby|camp rudder|ranger training brigade|\brtb\b
duties.clinic_hint: Ranger School sick-call notes often name the site, not the school: TMC #6 Dahlonega / Camp Merrill (mountain phase), Camp Rogers / Camp Darby (Fort Benning phase), Camp Rudder / Eglin (Florida phase).

duties.label: PT and fitness test training
duties.desc: Training for APFT/ACFT and other fitness tests (deadlifts, sprints, sled drags)
duties.proof: Profiles, fitness test records, sick call notes

duties.label: Field training and uneven terrain
duties.desc: Exercises, patrols, land navigation over rough ground

duties.label: Loud noise
duties.proof: MOS noise exposure, hearing tests, deployment records

duties.label: Blasts and explosions
duties.proof: Post-deployment forms, combat action badge, awards, TBI screenings

duties.label: Long-term sleep loss and shift work
duties.desc: Missions, staff duty, deployments with little sleep

duties.label: Burn pits, dust, fumes, chemicals
duties.desc: Burn pits, sand and dust, fuel, solvents
duties.proof: Deployment locations, PACT Act exposure screening
